title: truevalue
tagline: This project is investment platform where values flows users <-> creators.
description: This project is a web based music streaming/investing platform where each music is a separate entity. There exists an investment vault for each music entity in which user can invest as revenue sharing rights. these investments and revenue earned goes into vault which uses bi directional yield protocols, governed by DAO, that compounds these value. users are further allowed to use automated market maker as liquidity pools for further exchange and growth of music holdings. Nfts, vaults, Yp, AMM are deployed o chain and user access these through a web2 platform.
how_its_made: The project frontend is developed using next js and backend is being developed using node js. We have used privy for eth wallet and sui kit for sui wallet integration. ether js has been used to integrate contracts for ethereum along with 1 inch api for bidirectional swapping of eth<->sui.
